lines.text: He died on the old bridge. At 11:11.
[quiet, careful] I had to know why his watch stopped. So I asked.
[holding it together] My brother, Arjun. Three years ago.
[quiet, heavy] He died on the old bridge. At eleven eleven.
lines.show: He died on the old bridge. At 11:11.

lines.text: [soft] The same bridge. The same minute.
[a sad half-smile] He believed in signs. I never did.
[warm] I held his hand. This time, he let me.
[unsettled] Then he showed me a photo of Arjun.
[shaken, quiet] Three years ago, on that bridge, I held a stranger's hand until the ambulance came.
[barely a whisper] It was him. Arjun.
[slow, heavy] Now you know. You were there that night. That's why it has to be you.
